HanbokVisual.title: Traditional Palace & Royal Heritage Hanbok Styles
HanbokVisual.intro: Authentic full-length Joseon King dragon robes, aristocratic scholar dopo, and dignified royal court lady attire photographed in palace settings. Pick a style to apply its palette below.
HanbokVisual.genderToggleAria: Switch between feminine and masculine style references
HanbokVisual.notice: Photography features official heritage showcases and palace reenactments (Korea.net / KOCIS, CC BY-SA 2.0). All styles are authentic traditional Korean attire.

princess-prince.name: Princess / Prince
princess-prince.tagline: Luminous pastels · Perfect for palace photos

feminine.description: Classic graceful silhouette featuring an ivory silk jeogori with cerulean blue cuffs, elegant white ribbon goreum, and flowing silk chima with traditional Norigae. Beautiful, neat, and photogenic.
feminine.alt: Classic graceful silk chima-jeogori with Norigae tassel at Gyeongbokgung

masculine.description: Refined scholar prince in shimmering champagne-gold silk durumagi robe with crisp white collar, walking with effortless historical dignity.
masculine.alt: Noble scholar prince in champagne silk durumagi robe at Gyeongbokgung

feminine.description: Dignified royal court lady silhouette featuring a sheer white ceremonial cloak (jang-ot) draped over crimson silk jeogori and powder-blue pleated chima with traditional floral binyeo.
feminine.alt: Dignified court lady Hanbok with jang-ot cloak at Gyeongbokgung Hanbok Day

masculine.description: Dashing Joseon nobleman scholar in traditional black Gat (heungnip) and pleated scarlet dopo robe, projecting intellectual poise and timeless drama.
masculine.alt: Aristocratic Joseon scholar in scarlet dopo robe and traditional black Gat

feminine.description: Formal royal palace ceremonial court Hanbok in jade-gold Dangui and crimson Daeran chima adorned with heavy gold-foil dragon bands and royal Jokduri crown.
feminine.alt: Formal royal palace ceremonial court Hanbok with gold dragon bands and Jokduri crown

masculine.description: Iconic Joseon King scarlet royal dragon robe (Gonryongpo) with 5-clawed gold embroidered dragon roundels, royal jade belt, and Ikseongwan winged crown backed by the Sun, Moon & Five Peaks screen.
masculine.alt: Joseon King scarlet royal dragon robe Gonryongpo and Ikseongwan winged crown
